title: gymnanthemum senegalense
intro: Gymnanthemum senegalense, commonly known as Senegal tea or False Sage, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Gymnanthemum senegalense include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
